Python with function docstring, verify docstring count

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:tree_sitter_language_pack/tree_sitter_language_pack.dart';
import 'package:tree_sitter_language_pack/src/tree_sitter_language_pack_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final config = await createProcessConfigFromJson(json: '{"docstrings":true,"language":"python"}');
    final result = await TreeSitterLanguagePackBridge.process('def greet(name):\n    """Say hello to someone."""\n    return f"Hello {name}"\n', config: config);
    stdout.writeln(result.language);
    stdout.writeln(result.metrics.totalLines);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
